rule: A deployed version passes when, for each case, its answer carries the same facts as tool_output.

cases.question: Someone asks whether a supplied classification continues and whether the chosen routing address is one of the configured team destinations. Use the InboundRequestRoutingCheck tool on the sample.
cases.local_answer:
The classification continues: the check returned `continue: true`.

The chosen routing address is `facilities@contoso.example`. The check did not confirm whether that address is a configured team destination, because I didn't supply the list of team addresses. To verify it, I'd need the RoutingEmails mapping. Nothing was sent (`sent: false`).
